title: Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Addendum Price Computation Sheet
content:
# Fleet Addendum Price — Computation Sheet

**Formula clause.** A Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan addendum of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans is priced from the addendum's basis price, which is the plan's retail plan price: the Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit retail plan price. The fleet addendum price is that basis price rounded half up to the cent.

**Combination clause.** Where a rate applies to the addendum, it reduces the basis price once. Dollar credits that apply are then added together and subtracted from that reduced price. A result below 0.00 is 0.00, so the credits never make the price negative. The fleet addendum price is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

## Order of working
1. Start from the basis price.
2. Where a rate applies, reduce the basis price once by multiplying it by one less that rate.
3. Total the dollar credits that apply and subtract that total from the reduced price.
4. Where the result is below 0.00, take 0.00.
5. Round half up to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)
| Case | Basis price | Rate | Credits | Price |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: nothing further applies | 1,111.115 | none | none | 1,111.12 |
| B: rate and credits | 800.00 | 0.02 | 25.00 and 10.00 | 800.00 times 0.98 is 784.00; less 35.00 is 749.00 |
| C: credits exceed the reduced price | 30.00 | none | 45.00 | below 0.00, so 0.00 |

In case B the rate acts once on the basis price, and the credits come off the reduced price as one total. Rounding happens only after the subtraction. These rates and amounts are invented for illustration and are not company figures.
